title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature is crucial for handling HTTP requests with bodies, such as POST and PUT requests, allowing yantraverse to parse JSON and URL-encoded data. It will enable developers to easily access request data in their routes. This feature will improve the overall usability and versatility of the framework
acceptance: The feature is accepted when request bodies are correctly parsed and made available to route handlers, with proper error handling for invalid or missing bodies
reason: This feature is essential for building RESTful APIs and handling complex HTTP requests, making yantraverse more competitive with other Node.js frameworks
